text: ポケモン　タワーは　しんだ　ポケモンを　なぐさめるため　たてられた　とう　です

structure.jp: ポケモン　タワーは
しんだ　ポケモンを　なぐさめるため
structure.en: in order to console Pokémon that died

structure.jp: たてられた　とう　です
structure.en: is a tower that was built

patterns.name: 〜ため
patterns.explanation: ため after a plain verb means 'in order to do it'. なぐさめるため = 'in order to console'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb says the thing has the action done to it by someone. たてられた = 'was built'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. しんだ　ポケモン = 'Pokémon that died'.
